description: Convert a color code from one brand to its closest equivalents in another, e.g. Perler P38 → Hama, DMC 310 → Miyuki Delica, MARD A1 → Artkal. Ranked by CIEDE2000 deltaE.

code.description: The color code in the source palette.

from_palette.description: Palette ids or names (e.g. "dmc", "delica", "perler", "mard"). Ids: perler-midi, hama-midi, artkal-s, nabbi, mard-185, mard-221, mard-291, miyuki-delica, dmc-floss, dmc-diamond, lego, minecraft-blocks, minecraft-map, red-heart-super-saver, pixel-art-256.

to_palette.description: Palette ids or names (e.g. "dmc", "delica", "perler", "mard"). Ids: perler-midi, hama-midi, artkal-s, nabbi, mard-185, mard-221, mard-291, miyuki-delica, dmc-floss, dmc-diamond, lego, minecraft-blocks, minecraft-map, red-heart-super-saver, pixel-art-256.

name: convert_color
title: Convert a color code to another brand
